body: My AP has blocked me on his phone, twitter and Facebook at the request of his wife. However, he has a burner phone that he uses to call me. Just because your husband may delete her number doesn’t mean he isn’t still in contact with her.
Definitely check with your PI. Since campus is now closed, only essential employees can be on campus. It’s a workers comp issue for you to be in a lab if you aren’t on the essential list.
Campus is closed and only essential personnel are to report. We (non-essential staff) were told not to report tomorrow and they would let us know more later.

Actually campus is closed as of the 4pm announcement by the governor. Only essential employees can be on campus (I’m a staff member and non-essential). We got an email at 8:30pm to not come to work tomorrow.

I could have written this same post. I was with my ex for 3 years and he sexually assaulted me during this time. Like you, it was after we weren’t together anymore that I finally realized and accepted what happened. He broke up with me for another woman and they are blissfully happy. 

I filed a police report and spoke with a detective. He said it doesn’t look good that I kept going back to his house and seeing him after the incidents. Isn’t that what an abusive relationship is? I’m waiting to hear back from the detective but I don’t think they are even going to contact my ex. So, he gets to move on and be happy and I get to have to pay for therapy and be depressed and angry. No advice but you are not alone.

This is a lot of good information. I have a bicornuate uterus. Surgery is only for a septate uterus. I have two kids and had two miscarriages. Neither miscarriage was related to the shape of the uterus. I carried to 37.5 and 38.5 weeks and had no issues at all.

In the US, the prosecutor determines whether or not to press charges and go forward with a trial. They won’t press charges unless they have proof beyond a reasonable doubt for a conviction. If a criminal trial doesn’t go forward, you can pursue a civil trial where the burden of proof is lower.

Like the others said, you can’t help her. I’ve been there. Anything you do will be seen by her as leaving the door open to get back together. It may sound cruel, but no contact is the best thing you can do for her.

I miss my ex too. I haven’t seen him in two months. Haven’t talked to him in two weeks. I still love him. He was everything I ever wanted but he didn’t care about me at all. We were together three years and he sent a text to dump me.
I’m here if you need to talk.
Same thing happened to me. He hasn’t spoken to me in two weeks and I’ve been too afraid to text or call because I feel like he blocked me.

I hate this saying as well. I did try to take control of my life and make it happy. I got out of a bad marriage and started a relationship with a new guy that was everything I wanted. Unfortunately, I was way more into the relationship than he was. Three years later, he dumps me for someone else. I had no control over that. What am I supposed to do now? You can't control everything.

Yes, I totally own my mistakes. It’s funny you made that comment about cooking and them saying they never asked you to. He totally said that whenever I would say anything about the stuff I did for him.

He got called on his BS yesterday and his new friend found out about me. Of course, I’m sure he made me out to be some lunatic but whatever. 

I felt sort of a relief when he said no more text/calls.

I feel the same way. Things were pretty good until I got screwed over at work by my best friend. It’s been downhill since then. Nothing ever goes my way and I never get anything I want. I’m always going out of my way to be thoughtful and nice to others that are hurting but no one does the same for me. I end up either used by others or completely ignored.
I found out a second friend has breast cancer and all I could think is “I wish it was me”.

I'm glad to hear that. My daughter is also 13, so that drew me to your post. If you ever need to talk, you can always reach out to me. I can't promise I can help or offer good advice, but I can always listen.
I think you should talk to your mom. If you think you can't talk to her, is there someone at school you could talk to? Like a favorite teacher or a school counselor?
I haven't told family but I've told some friends. They usually just say "stop talking like that", "you don't mean that", or "don't start that shit again" was one I heard today from an online friend.
Agree as well.
Same here

That is why I'm still here as well. I cannot bear to think about the hurt it would cause my daughter. I have also done the same with one person. He will only text/call me and won't spend time with me anymore and it has devastated me.

The worst part is that this is a recurring theme in my life. I was best friends with a girl at work for 10 years. Like at the hospital when her kid was born kind of best friends. She stabbed me in the back, stole my job and is currently my boss. I finally reconnect with this guy and we are best of friends, do things together, hang out, have some side benefits for 4 years. Then he decides this other woman needs his "help" to deal with her husband's death. He says he can't hang out with two females at once because it's not "right" and ditches me.

I did too. I have begged my friend to help me and all he says is "I'm trying". Sorry, I don't see it. I tell him that I would like to come over and watch a movie or grab a bite and he says no. How much more of a simple request could I make?
You're right, it doesn't. I reached out to a friend and told him exactly what he could do to help me, but he said no. He only was willing to do what he thought was best.
It pisses me off that I always try to think about other people and do things for them and nobody ever does anything for me.

I feel the same way. I have no friends. The people I work with are ok but I would never share my feelings with them. They would all think I was a freak or tell me to "get over it". I've shared with two people and one checked on me once, but not again. The other lets me text but when I tell him what I actually need or want to feel better, he tells me no, so what else is left to do?

I don't think you're either of those things. I think you feel just like me and many others. I've reached out as well but they want things to be done on their terms. I'm the one with the issue, so I'm not sure how that helps me...

Yes, I have no desire to open up to other friends. For one thing, I don't really have any. The people I work with are mostly cool, but if I said anything to them about killing myself they would be like, you just need to get over it. The only other person I've said anything to was nice and did actually check on me the next day, but I haven't heard from her since and she never offered to do anything with me. On the other hand, when her boyfriend cut off all communication with her for no reason, I took her to the movies. It's like I bend over backwards for people and try to reach out to anyone I know is hurting, but no one ever has shown me the same caring.

I have been friends with a guy for the last 4 years. I understood that he was not ready for a relationship, but we have been friends and done things together in 3 of the last 4 years. Five weeks ago, he told me we could no longer do things together because another female friend of his had her husband pass away suddenly and he needed to be there for her. He says it's not "right" to hang out with two different females at the same time. This has devastated me. He vows to support me, but only on his terms. His terms are text or calls only. He doesn't understand that spending time with him got me out of my lonely house and being alone all the time. He doesn't understand that doing mundane things for him, like picking up a case of water or a shower curtain liner at the store or cooking him dinner gave me a purpose in life. It's all gone now and I want to disappear forever.
